Guests will love the 2 spacious front porches, premium appliances, and professionally decorated interiors.A cute front porch and a large gas grill welcome guests to Blue Mountain Seacret. Inside, guests will find a delightful open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area professionally decorated in soothing shades of blue and white. A wrap-around queen sleeper sofa and armchairs surround a 65” Smart TV, and an adjacent dining table seats 6 with room to spare. Gleaming white countertops and deep blue chevron tiles in the kitchen beautifully frame a Viking 6-burner gas range and Viking premium appliances. In the bunkroom, 2 twin-over-twin built-in bunk beds are designed with cute ship-lap walls, shelving, and criss-cross bed guards. Guests staying in the primary bedroom will enjoy private access to the second-floor porch. Guests can put their feet up, unwind on a cushioned wicker sofa, and enjoy beach breezes and views of the neighborhood. Inside the room is a king bed, a 50” Smart TV, a spacious bathroom with a soaking tub, a double vanity, and a glass-enclosed shower with a built-in bench.It’s easy to explore Blue Mountain Beach and surrounding 30A communities with 4 included adult bikes and 6 passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. Popular spots like Grayton Beach State Park, WaterColor, and Seaside are within a 4-mile bike ride on a paved bike path.
